## How does invoice automation actually work?


Invoice automation works as a loop: an event kicks it off, the app generates and sends the invoice, then it watches for payment and follows up until the money lands. With[Taskade Genesis](https://www.taskade.com/automate) , every step is a reliable, durable automation — it can wait days, check Stripe, and resume from the exact step that failed instead of restarting.

## What can you automate in the invoicing workflow?


You can automate the entire billing cycle — generation, math, payment tracking, and reminders — not just one piece. Here is what each part does and the manual chore it replaces:


Step What the automation does What it replaces


**Generate** AI agent drafts a branded invoice with client details and line items Copy-pasting last month's invoice


**Calculate** Built-in calculator sums line items, tax, and discounts Manual spreadsheet math (and errors)


**Send** Pushes the invoice via native Stripe + emails a PDF Downloading and attaching files by hand


**Track** Updates status to Paid, Pending, or Overdue from Stripe events Checking your bank and updating a sheet


**Remind** Durable workflow nudges only clients who still owe you Setting calendar reminders you forget


**Report** Weekly summary of outstanding balances and cash flow Building a manual month-end roll-up


Three Taskade Genesis pillars make this work together — Memory holds your clients and past invoices, Intelligence reads payment events and decides what to do, and Execution runs the reminders. It is one self-reinforcing loop:


## How do you build an invoice automation step by step?


You build it by describing the result you want, then refining with the AI agent. There is no setup wizard and no code. Here is the practical sequence for an operator starting from scratch.


### Step 1 — Describe the app in one prompt


Open[Taskade Genesis](https://www.taskade.com/create?entry_kind=content&source=blog&entry=%2Fblog%2Fai-invoice-automation) and type what you want in plain English:


> *"Build an invoice app. Generate branded PDF invoices with line items and tax, track payment status as Paid, Pending, or Overdue, charge clients through Stripe, and send a reminder every 3 days until they pay."*


Taskade Genesis builds the app, the database, the AI agent, and the automations from that single sentence.


### Step 2 — Connect Stripe (and Shopify if you sell products)


Stripe is one of[100+ bidirectional integrations](https://www.taskade.com/wiki/genesis/ai-workflow-builder) — triggers pull payment events in, actions push invoice data out. Connect it once and your app marks invoices paid the moment money clears, with no manual reconciliation.


### Step 3 — Let the AI agent watch and act


The built-in AI agent has **built-in tools** — it can read incoming payment events, recalculate balances, decide which clients are overdue, and trigger the right follow-up. For bigger billing operations, agents can work together in[orchestration mode](https://www.taskade.com/wiki/ai-agents/agent-orchestration) : one drafts, one reconciles payments, one handles reminders.


### Step 4 — Publish and hand it to your team or clients


Publish the app on a[custom domain](https://www.taskade.com/wiki/genesis/custom-domains) with built-in sign-in. Your bookkeeper, your assistant, or a client can log in and see exactly which invoices are outstanding — no spreadsheet shared over email.


### Step 5 — Track everything in the view that fits


Every invoice lives in a Project you can see[7 ways](https://www.taskade.com/wiki/genesis/projects) — List, Board, Calendar, Table, Mind Map, Gantt, and Org Chart (Timeline lives inside the Gantt view). A Board with Paid, Pending, and Overdue columns is the fastest way to see where your cash is.
